description: A cardboard box sits on the right side of a bed-like surface, with a notebook and pen on the left, a gray pad in the middle, and scattered items like a bottle, a paper cup, and two pieces of clothing nearby. The left hand steadies and pulls the cardboard box closer while the right hand reaches back to pick up a black-and-red bottle and drops it into the box, then adds a white paper cup and a small packet; next the right hand lifts an orange shirt and stuffs it on top, then grabs a green garment and piles it into the box while the left hand keeps holding the box in place.
